text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I did it! I didn't sully the title of model
student! A
superhuman force! MEGA
BAKUSHIN!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
No need to hold back! Go ahead and
shower me
with praise!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
choice_data_list: 手本になる走りだった！

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Being able to run spectacularly is the
foundation
of being the class
representative after all!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Okay! Leave it to me! The legendary
genius,
Sakura Bakushin O!
choice_data_list_en: I'm counting on you next time too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Let's aim for victory together!
BAKUSHIIIN!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Wowza! But you think I got what it takes
to be a
champion?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Basically you're telling me how much you
believe
in my next victory, right? Right?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh! As a genius, it would be an
embarrassment
if I couldn't live up to
your expectations!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Come wind or rain! Or even the fires of
hell! I will
Bakushin to victory!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even though I meant something
different, it
appears to have had a
positive effect on Sakura
Bakushin O.
